description: Implement all mobile service layer files, the three new shared components (ServiceCard, VehicleCard, BookingCard), and all customer-facing screens (MyVehicles, AddVehicle, EditVehicle, Services, ServiceDetails, booking flow, MyBookings, BookingDetails, Notifications, Profile, EditProfile). Update CustomerNavigator to full 5-tab layout and upgrade CustomerHomeScreen from stub to live-data implementation.
steps: CREATE mobile/src/services/vehicleService.js — functions: getMyVehicles() → api.get('/vehicles/my'), addVehicle(data) → api.post('/vehicles', data), getVehicle(id) → api.get('/vehicles/'+id), updateVehicle(id,data) → api.put('/vehicles/'+id, data), deleteVehicle(id) → api.delete('/vehicles/'+id). Each returns response.data.

CREATE mobile/src/services/serviceService.js — getServices() → api.get('/services'), getService(id) → api.get('/services/'+id). Also add admin functions: createService(data), updateService(id,data), deleteService(id) pointing to /admin/services paths.

CREATE mobile/src/services/bookingService.js — createBooking(data) → api.post('/bookings', data), getMyBookings() → api.get('/bookings/my'), getBooking(id) → api.get('/bookings/'+id), cancelBooking(id,reason) → api.put('/bookings/'+id+'/cancel', {cancelReason:reason}), getAvailability(date) → api.get('/availability?date='+date). Admin: getAdminBookings(params) → api.get('/admin/bookings', {params}), updateBookingStatus(id,status) → api.put('/admin/bookings/'+id+'/status', {status}).

CREATE mobile/src/services/paymentService.js — getMyPayments() → api.get('/payments/my'), getPayment(id) → api.get('/payments/'+id). Admin: getAdminPayments(params) → api.get('/admin/payments', {params}), updatePaymentStatus(id,status) → api.put('/admin/payments/'+id+'/status', {status}).

CREATE mobile/src/services/notificationService.js — getMyNotifications() → api.get('/notifications'), markRead(id) → api.put('/notifications/'+id+'/read'), markAllRead() → api.put('/notifications/read-all').
UPDATE mobile/src/services/authService.js — add updateProfile(data) → api.put('/auth/profile', data) and changePassword(data) → api.put('/auth/change-password', data).

CREATE mobile/src/components/ServiceCard.js — props: service (object with name, category, price, duration, vehicleTypes, imageUrl), onPress. Renders a card with service name (lg semibold), category badge using StatusBadge-style view, price (ocean color, bold), duration in minutes, vehicle type chips. Touchable wrapper with colors.white bg, borderRadius.md, elevation. Uses colors, spacing, typography.

CREATE mobile/src/components/VehicleCard.js — props: vehicle (object with type, make, model, year, licensePlate, color, isActive), onPress, onEdit (optional), onDelete (optional). Shows vehicle type icon (Ionicons: car/bicycle/etc), make+model as title, license plate in a pill badge, color dot, isActive badge. Shows edit/delete icon buttons if callbacks provided. Card bg white, rounded, elevation 2.

CREATE mobile/src/components/BookingCard.js — props: booking (object with service {name}, vehicle {make,model}, scheduledDate, scheduledTime, status, totalAmount), onPress. Shows service name, vehicle make+model, formatted date+time, StatusBadge for status, amount in ocean color. Touchable card.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/MyVehiclesScreen.js — AppHeader 'My Vehicles' with + button top-right (navigate to AddVehicle). FlatList of VehicleCard. On mount: load vehicles via vehicleService.getMyVehicles(). Pull-to-refresh. EmptyState with 'Add your first vehicle' action. ConfirmDialog for delete with vehicleService.deleteVehicle. LoadingView while loading. ErrorView on error with retry.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/AddVehicleScreen.js — AppHeader 'Add Vehicle' with back. Form: vehicle type picker (Picker-style TouchableOpacity selector using VEHICLE_TYPES), make (AppInput), model (AppInput), year (AppInput numeric), licensePlate (AppInput optional), color (AppInput optional), photo (TouchableOpacity launches ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync with permissions). Submit calls vehicleService.addVehicle. Inline validation errors. Navigate back on success with success toast/alert.
CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/EditVehicleScreen.js — identical to AddVehicle but pre-fills from route.params.vehicle and calls vehicleService.updateVehicle(id, data). AppHeader 'Edit Vehicle'.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/ServicesScreen.js — AppHeader 'Services'. Load services via serviceService.getServices(). Horizontal filter tabs: All, Exterior, Interior, Full, Premium (filter by category). FlatList of ServiceCard with onPress navigating to ServiceDetails screen passing service object. Pull-to-refresh. EmptyState. LoadingView.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/ServiceDetailsScreen.js — receives service via route.params.service. AppHeader with back. Shows service name (xxxl bold), category badge, price (ocean, xxl bold), duration, description, vehicleTypes chips, imageUrl placeholder if no image. 'Book This Service' AppButton at bottom navigates to BookWash screen passing serviceId.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/BookWashScreen.js — AppHeader 'Book a Wash'. Step 1: vehicle selection — shows user's vehicles as selectable cards (highlight selected). If no vehicles, show empty state with 'Add Vehicle' button. Step 2: service shown (if came from ServiceDetails, pre-selected; otherwise show service list). 'Continue' AppButton navigates to SelectDateTime with {vehicleId, serviceId}.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/SelectDateTimeScreen.js — AppHeader 'Select Date & Time'. Simple date picker: show current month with TouchableOpacity day cells in a 7-column grid. Highlight today, disable past dates, mark unavailable dates (booked out). On date select, call bookingService.getAvailability(dateString), render time slot chips (grid of TouchableOpacity pills, available=enabled ocean, unavailable=gray). 'Continue' navigates to BookingReview with {vehicleId, serviceId, date, time}.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/BookingReviewScreen.js — AppHeader 'Review Booking'. Shows: selected vehicle card (compact), selected service name+price, date+time, total amount. 'Confirm & Pay' AppButton navigates to PaymentScreen with booking params.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/PaymentScreen.js — AppHeader 'Payment'. Two payment method cards: COD (Cash on Delivery) and Razorpay (with note: 'Razorpay requires merchant account setup — coming soon', show as disabled/greyed). COD selected by default. 'Pay ₹{amount}' AppButton: for COD calls bookingService.createBooking({...params, paymentMethod:'cod'}). On success navigate to BookingSuccess. On error show inline error.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/BookingSuccessScreen.js — Full-screen success view: large checkmark icon (Ionicons checkmark-circle, success green), 'Booking Confirmed!' heading, booking ID, scheduled date+time, 'View My Bookings' AppButton (navigate to MyBookings tab), 'Go Home' ghost button. No back navigation (replace stack).

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/MyBookingsScreen.js — AppHeader 'My Bookings'. Status filter tabs: All, Pending, Confirmed, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled (horizontal ScrollView). On mount/filter change: load bookingService.getMyBookings() and filter client-side. FlatList of BookingCard with onPress navigating to BookingDetails. Pull-to-refresh. EmptyState per filter. LoadingView.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/BookingDetailsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Booking Details' with back. Loads bookingService.getBooking(id) from route.params.bookingId. Shows: service name/price, vehicle info, date/time, StatusBadge, payment method+status. 'Cancel Booking' AppButton (only if status is pending or confirmed): shows TextInput for reason + ConfirmDialog, calls bookingService.cancelBooking(id, reason). LoadingView while loading.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/NotificationsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Notifications' with 'Mark All Read' text button right side. FlatList of notification items (title bold, body text, time ago, blue left border if unread). On mount load notificationService.getMyNotifications(). Tap calls markRead(id). Pull-to-refresh. EmptyState. LoadingView.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/ProfileScreen.js — No header (safe area only). Shows: avatar circle (initials from user.name if no photo, ocean bg), user name (xxl bold), email, phone, member since date. Menu list items: Edit Profile, Change Password, My Vehicles, My Bookings, Notifications. Logout row at bottom with red text + ConfirmDialog.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/customer/EditProfileScreen.js — AppHeader 'Edit Profile' with back. Pre-fills name, phone from AuthContext user. Avatar with ImagePicker. Submit calls authService.updateProfile(). On success updates AuthContext user (add updateUser action to AuthContext if needed) and navigates back.

UPDATE mobile/src/navigation/CustomerNavigator.js — replace stub with full bottom-tab + nested stack implementation. 5 tabs: Home (stack: CustomerHome → AddVehicle, EditVehicle, MyVehicles), Services (stack: Services → ServiceDetails → BookWash → SelectDateTime → BookingReview → Payment → BookingSuccess), Bookings (stack: MyBookings → BookingDetails), Notifications, Profile (stack: Profile → EditProfile). Tab icons: home, sparkles, car-sport (center, ocean circle bg), calendar, person. AppHeader hidden at tab level (each screen handles its own header).

UPDATE mobile/src/screens/customer/CustomerHomeScreen.js — replace all SectionPlaceholder stubs with real sections. On mount: fetch vehicles (vehicleService.getMyVehicles()), bookings (bookingService.getMyBookings()), services (serviceService.getServices()). Show: 2 most recent vehicles as VehicleCards or EmptyState; 3 most recent bookings as BookingCards or EmptyState; 3 featured services as ServiceCards. Pull-to-refresh. Quick action 'Book a Wash' hero button navigates to BookWash screen. LoadingView on initial load.

UPDATE mobile/src/navigation/RootNavigator.js — remove the manual screen registrations for individual auth screens inside the authenticated branches (they are only needed in unauthenticated state). Ensure CustomerNavigator receives no extra wrapper that would break tab navigation.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 mobile service files exist: vehicleService.js, serviceService.js, bookingService.js, paymentService.js, notificationService.js
All 3 shared components exist: ServiceCard.js, VehicleCard.js, BookingCard.js

All customer screens exist in mobile/src/screens/customer/: MyVehicles, AddVehicle, EditVehicle, Services, ServiceDetails, BookWash, SelectDateTime, BookingReview, Payment, BookingSuccess, MyBookings, BookingDetails, Notifications, Profile, EditProfile
CustomerNavigator.js implements 5 bottom tabs with proper nested stacks for all screens
CustomerHomeScreen.js fetches and renders live data (vehicles, bookings, services) replacing all SectionPlaceholder stubs
'cd mobile && npx expo export --platform android' exits 0 with no errors
verification: cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\mobile && npx expo export --platform android -- confirm exit code 0 and 'Export was successful' in output
findings: All 5 service files created (vehicleService, serviceService, bookingService, paymentService, notificationService). authService updated with updateProfile and changePassword. All 3 shared components created (ServiceCard, VehicleCard, BookingCard). All 15 customer screens created (MyVehicles, AddVehicle, EditVehicle, Services, ServiceDetails, BookWash, SelectDateTime, BookingReview, Payment, BookingSuccess, MyBookings, BookingDetails, Notifications, Profile, EditProfile). CustomerNavigator replaced with full 6-tab layout (HomeTab, ServicesTab, BookTab CTA, BookingsTab, NotificationsTab, ProfileTab) using nested stacks. CustomerHomeScreen upgraded from stub to live data with pull-to-refresh. AuthContext updated with UPDATE_USER action and updateUser function. Build confirmed: npx expo export --platform android exits 0 with 1160 modules bundled. Integration cross-check: all service file API paths verified against server routes — all match. CustomerHomeScreen and MyBookingsScreen use data.data fallback pattern which correctly handles { success: true, data: [...] } server responses.
